subject: science
concept: Understanding that living things have offspring similar to, but not identical to, their parents
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Life Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Heredity) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student compares pictures of animal parents and their offspring, noting similarities and differences
exercise.pictorial: Student matches baby animals to their correct parent animal
exercise.abstract: Student lists one similarity and one difference between a parent and offspring pair

misconception_flags: assumes offspring are always identical copies of the parent

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
